# uml-overview-svgs

The rendered SVGs for the pages above — same generator, its `SVG_ROOT` (line 76), 266 files on `main`. A separate entry rather than one covering both because they are two directories with two paths, and a declaration states where to look. **`storage` is deliberately NOT set on either entry.** `DirectoryStorageSchema`'s docblock, §"Not yet set on any declaration": *"Setting it earlier would tell the presence checks to stop looking while the readers still read the checkout."* So the order is declare, seed the branch, migrate `uml:overview:check`, and only then flip — `xsrv`'s Done-when 1 bundles the first and last of those into one line, and this is the first.

Part of [C@T Harness](../../../../../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `uml-overview-svgs`, holding `auto-docs`.
